Former Australian of the Year Grace Tame has again been stalked and harassed by people claiming to be Jewish, such as Avi Yemini and ABC radio host Charlie Pickering, because she has hosted a 4-part podcast series for the ABC on autism.

As you will see from the evidence below, it is almost certain that Avi Yemini, with help from Australian Zionist Jews such as the Australian Jewish Association, set up a fake protest outside the ABC in Melbourne on Tuesday (2/6/26) designed solely to undermine Grace Tame’s podcast series that was launched the same day.

The ABC reported on Tuesday, the 2nd of June 2026:

The ABC today announced Autistic AF with Grace Tame, a powerful new Ladies, We Need To Talk podcast series premiering Tuesday 2 June on ABC listen and ABC Australia’s YouTube Channel. (Click here to read more)

Australian Jews, with all of them seeming to be pro-Israel Zionists, have decided Grace Tame should be silenced for life because she upset them by saying, “From Gadigal to Gaza, globalise the intifada,” at a protest in Sydney in February 2026 against the Australian visit of Israeli President Isaac Herzog.

Saying “globalise the intifada” is not a crime in NSW although it has been recently criminalised in Queensland.

The irony is the Jewish community’s pin-up boy Avi Yemini, who has a conviction for assaulting his former wife after throwing a chopping board at her head, has admitted on video to shooting Palestinians in Gaza who were throwing rocks, and it is well known that many of the rock throwers in the past have been children.

Avi Yemini’s history of stalking Grace Tame

It was well known that Avi Yemini has been stalking Grace Tame for some time.

Women’s Agenda posted on the 17th of February 2026:

Rebel News, whose Australian face is convicted family violence perpetrator Avi Yemeni, launched a petition to have her stripped of the award and criminally charged. Israel’s deputy foreign minister called her behaviour “absolutely outrageous.” The calls to prosecute her for inciting violence came thick and fast. Social media did what social media does to women who refuse to perform compliance, it turned feral.

Tame, characteristically, didn’t flinch. “In the pursuit of justice, proportion, fairness, and truth, I refuse to be silent,” she wrote. “I am not the story.”

She’s right. She is not the story. (Click here to read more)

Ette Media posted on the 4th of June 2026:

Avi Yemini, a former IDF marksman turned far right influencer who this week interviewed ABC personality Charlie Pickering over criticism of Grace Tame’s ABC podcast series, has previously mounted campaigns against the former Australian of the Year — including using a website domain that bears her name and redirects users to a petition seeking to strip her of her title.

Ette Media can reveal that the domain www.gracetame.com has been redirecting visitors to populist website Rebel News and a petition targeting Tame since at least February this year. In posts promoting the campaign, Yemini referred to it as “my petition” and argued Tame should be “stripped of her honour and charged for incitement”. The petition has attracted more than 39,000 signatures and Tame is considering her legal options. (Click here to read more)

On Tuesday (2/6/26), a pro-Israel rent-a-crowd was organised to protest outside the ABC in Melbourne under the banner “Defund the ABC,” which was designed to disguise that it was organised by pro-Israel supporters and Avi Yemini.

The focus of the “Defund the ABC” protest was clearly on Grace Tame and her new podcast, and Avi Yemini didn’t even try to hide that fact.

The SMH reported (2/6/26) in an article titled “Charlie Pickering joins criticism of ABC’s Grace Tame podcast deal”:

While Tame’s podcast is focused on autism rather than politics and current affairs, the ABC’s appointment of her drew swift criticism from Australian Jewish Association chief executive Robert Gregory.

“At first, I thought the ABC announcement was a joke. I simply could not believe that Australia’s public broadcaster could be so tone-deaf,” Gregory said. “The question Australians should be asking is simple: with so many talented and respected people available, why did the ABC choose Grace Tame?”

Meanwhile, ABC Drive host Pickering entered the fray when he emerged from the ABC studios in Melbourne on Tuesday to speak with a group protesting the ABC’s perceived political bias, and during an interview with serial right-wing agitator Avi Yemini when he voiced his concern about Tame’s appointment.

“I do actually think it is problematic,” Pickering said. “That is my personal opinion, and I think … as a Jewish Australian, there is a complete misunderstanding of a lot of the words that are said and what the true meaning of them are, and a lot of people are using words and phrases that have meaning well beyond what they think they do. (Click here to read more)

Charlie Pickering has since done a backflip and said he was “a big fan of Grace Tame”.

The fake “Defund the ABC” protest outside the ABC in Melbourne

The fake “Defund the ABC” protest would likely not have received a mention in any media, but having Charlie Pickering do an interview with Avi Yemini and attacking Grace Tame made sure it received national media exposure which was clearly the plan.

Murdoch propagandist Gerard Henderson wrote a story for Sky News and said, “Pickering visited an anti-Tame protest outside the ABC’s Southbank studio in Melbourne,” so even Henderson knew it was a fake “Defund the ABC” protest and it was all about attacking Grace Tame.

Below is a video that Avi Yemini posted on “X” (2 days after the protest) which was on Tuesday (2/6/26) at the ABC in Melbourne.

In the video most of the people attack Grace Tame and the ethics of the ABC for hiring her, but they are all happy to be interviewed by convicted wife beater Avi Yemini, who is a former soldier in the Israeli Defence Force (IDF) who has bragged about shooting people in Gaza for throwing stones.

In the above video at the 40 second mark, Dean Hurlston is interviewed and named as the protest organiser. At the 5.56 mark, Hurlston goes on a rant about the ABC hiring Grace Tame.

At the 7.30 mark, Hurlston says he is not Jewish or Persian, he is an Aussie. Great, an impartial person.

If you google Dean Hurlston and Murdoch’s Israel supporting Sky News, you will find numerous videos of Hurlston being interviewed on Sky News by various hosts, including one attacking Palestinian supporters and defending Israel.

So, Hurlston is hardly impartial and was almost certainly tapped on the shoulder and possibly paid to act as the organiser. But it gets worse.

What Hurlston doesn’t say in the above video is he was busted for stalking and harassing a female mayor last year.

The ABC reported on the 1st of July 2025:

“The head of a ratepayer advocacy group has been hit with a two-year intervention order after a magistrate ruled he stalked and harassed an inner-city Melbourne mayor under the guise of political discourse, and was likely to do so again.

Stonnington mayor Melina Sehr was on Tuesday granted a Personal Safety Intervention Order (PSIO) against Council Watch president Dean Hurlston over allegations Mr Hurlston had harassed her for six years.

The magistrate also said personal malice could not be concealed “under the superficial veneer of political discourse or public-interest journalism”.

She said Mr Hurlston knew his conduct would cause harm or fear of harm.

The court heard from three other current and former female Stonnington councillors who alleged Mr Hurlston also targeted them and continued to do so despite repeated requests to stop. (Click here to read more)

So, in the above video you have one stalker and harasser of females, Avi Yemini, interviewing another stalker and harasser of females, Dean Hurlston, while they jointly stalk and harass Grace Tame in the video.

When the magistrate said last year that Dean Hurlston “stalked and harassed an inner-city Melbourne mayor under the guise of political discourse, and was likely to do so again” he was right on the money, although given the two-year intervention order, he has changed targets to Grace Tame.

Stalking and harassing people under the guise of political discourse is exactly how Avi Yemini and the Israel lobby work as well.

Everyone in the above video outside the ABC attacking Grace Tame should be charged with stalking and harassment because they all knew that was what they were there to do.

The above article is not a one-off, with Australian Jews attacking people, especially women, trying to destroy them. I was actually working on another article along the same lines when the above happened. I will publish the other article soon.
